mentions.name: Terminal file deduper
mentions.description: A CLI/terminal file deduplication tool that opens an ncurses interface when pointed at a directory, recursively scans and hashes files to group duplicates, and ranks the dupes in a top-like table so users can choose which copies to keep entirely from the keyboard. It auto-ignores developer directories like node_modules, offers a preview mode (key 'p') that autoplays duplicate videos in muted tiles for media files, and supports a dry run mode plus sending duplicates to trash instead of hard deletion.
mentions.problem: Moving many files from an old laptop to a new one leaves lots of duplicate videos in scattered directories with different file names.
